title.zh: 【Iron Fish：正调查 Base 上 wIRON 异常发行，暂无法保证足额 1:1 支持】
title.en: 【Iron Fish：正调查 Base 上 wIRON 异常发行，暂无法保证足额 1:1 支持】

current_state.zh: Iron Fish said it is investigating an abnormal issuance of wIRON on Base, has asked ChainPort for an emergency review, and warned users to avoid buying the token or using the bridge because full 1:1 asset backing can no longer be assured.
current_state.en: Iron Fish said it is investigating an abnormal issuance of wIRON on Base, has asked ChainPort for an emergency review, and warned users to avoid buying the token or using the bridge because full 1:1 asset backing can no longer be assured.
